sloka: हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महद्बलम् ।रक्षसामप्रहृष्टानां लङ्कामभिजगाम ह ।। ६.५८.५७ ।।।।
transliteration: hate prahaste nīlena tadakampyaṁ mahadbalam ।rakṣasāmaprahṛṣṭānāṁ laṅkāmabhijagāma ha ।। 6.58.57 ।।।।

translations.english: From his shattered head much blood flowed from all over the body just as a spring from a mountain.
